assumptions: The object is addressed by its field offsets only; no meaning is assigned to the object or to its +0x70 field.
The lookup routine's own semantics are not claimed here; only its observed branch effect at the sole site is recorded: a zero return takes the null arm, a nonzero return falls through past it.
A missing field is a modelling gap, not a binary behavior: the model raises ValueError, while the binary would read whatever bytes lie at that address.

The [rbp-0x540] slot is described as never re-read inside the caller function because a whole-function scan of the caller (0x5d69a00..0x5d6a6d9) finds that stack displacement exactly once, at the storing instruction.

census.note: One direct call to the incrementer leaf (0x5d8d0b0), at 0x5d69d70; no tail jumps, no stored qwords, no RELATIVE addends.

distinct_from: Open PR #2397 (field accessors 0x5d8d0c0/0x5d8d0d0/0x5d8d0e0): the immediately following leaves on the same +0x70 field; the incrementer at 0x5d8d0b0 precedes them and is not claimed there.
Open PR #2378 (record-fill 0x5f6eb50) and #2374 (advance/max leaves 0x5f6f400/0x5f6f430): consumers of the getter and raiser, not of the incrementer; no address overlap.
No open PR title hit for 5d8d0b0 or incrementer; code search for 5d8d0b0 in lalalune/hyperliquid-source returns 0 hits.

fields.rule: read, incremented by 1 modulo 2**32, and stored back by the leaf at 0x5d8d0b0; the new value is returned in eax

leaf.returns: the new dword at obj+0x70 (after adding 1, wrapping modulo 2**32)

site.branch: the caller calls the lookup routine 0x5d8cf70 with (rdi = qword at [qword at [r13+0x68] + 0x40], rsi = qword at [rbp-0x9b8]); a zero return jumps to the null arm at 0x5d69d38; a nonzero return falls through past the jump and never reaches the incrementer on that path
null_arm: stack-object preparation at 0x5d69d38..0x5d69d67 (a call at 0x5d69d49, then an assign PLT call at 0x5d69d63 with rdi = stack address [rbp-0x538] and rsi = qword at [rbp-0x9b8])
incrementer call at 0x5d69d70 with the argument above
the returned value stored at [rbp-0x540] at 0x5d69d75; that stack slot is never read again inside the caller function
site.taken_arm: the fall-through path from 0x5d69cc6 ends with a jump to 0x5d69aff at 0x5d69d2c; the intervening calls on that path are not claimed
